content: After Saul and Jonathan died, what did David take up for them?
explanation: David mourned his king and his friend. “Then David took up this lament for Saul and his son Jonathan” (2 Samuel 1:17, BSB)

content: After Saul's death, the men of Judah anointed David king in which town?
explanation: He first ruled only Judah. “Then the men of Judah came to Hebron, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah.” (2 Samuel 2:4, BSB)

content: How old was David when he became king?
explanation: He reigned forty years. “David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.” (2 Samuel 5:4, BSB)

content: What fortress did King David capture, later called the City of David?
explanation: It became his capital, Jerusalem. “Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).” (2 Samuel 5:7, BSB)

content: As the ark was brought to Jerusalem, what did King David do before the LORD?
explanation: He rejoiced in God. “And David, wearing a linen ephod, danced with all his might before the LORD” (2 Samuel 6:14, BSB)

content: Why was King David troubled about his cedar house?
options: God's ark was in a tent
explanation: He wanted to build a house for God. “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent.” (2 Samuel 7:2, BSB)

content: What did God promise about King David's throne?
explanation: Jesus came from David's line. “Your house and kingdom will endure forever before Me, and your throne will be established forever.” (2 Samuel 7:16, BSB)

content: For whose sake did King David want to show kindness to Saul's family?
explanation: Jonathan had been his loyal friend. “Is there anyone left from the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for the sake of Jonathan?” (2 Samuel 9:1, BSB)

content: What did King David promise Jonathan's lame son Mephibosheth?
options: To always eat at his table
explanation: David kept his promise to Jonathan. “and you will always eat at my table.” (2 Samuel 9:7, BSB)

content: Which prophet did the LORD send to King David after his sin with Bathsheba?
explanation: He told a story to show David his sin. “Then the LORD sent Nathan to David” (2 Samuel 12:1, BSB)

content: In Nathan's story to David, what did the poor man own?
explanation: The rich man took it. “but the poor man had nothing except one small ewe lamb that he had bought.” (2 Samuel 12:3, BSB)

content: After his story about the stolen lamb, what did Nathan tell David?
explanation: David saw his own sin. “You are that man!” (2 Samuel 12:7, BSB)

content: When confronted by Nathan, what did King David confess?
options: I have sinned against the LORD
explanation: God took away his sin. “I have sinned against the LORD.” (2 Samuel 12:13, BSB)

content: What did David and Bathsheba name the son the LORD loved?
explanation: He later became king. “So she gave birth to a son, and they named him Solomon. Now the LORD loved the child” (2 Samuel 12:24, BSB)

content: In his song of praise, what did King David call the LORD?
explanation: God was his safe place. “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.” (2 Samuel 22:2, BSB)

content: In David's lament, Saul and Jonathan were swifter than what?
explanation: They were also stronger than lions. “They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.” (2 Samuel 1:23, BSB)

content: During the long war between Saul's house and David's house, who grew stronger?
explanation: Saul's house grew weaker. “And David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.” (2 Samuel 3:1, BSB)

content: Which people held Jerusalem before King David captured it?
explanation: They said David could never get in. “Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land.” (2 Samuel 5:6, BSB)

content: Which king sent cedar logs and builders to build King David's palace?
explanation: Tyre was famous for cedar. “Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, carpenters, and stonemasons” (2 Samuel 5:11, BSB)

content: Whose house was blessed while God's ark stayed there before going to Jerusalem?
explanation: Then David brought the ark up with joy. “The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that belongs to him, because of the ark of God.” (2 Samuel 6:12, BSB)

content: Who looked from a window and despised King David for dancing before the ark?
explanation: David was worshiping with all his heart. “Saul’s daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD” (2 Samuel 6:16, BSB)

content: God told David that his descendant, not David, would build what?
explanation: Solomon built the temple. “He will build a house for My Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.” (2 Samuel 7:13, BSB)

content: What did Ziba tell King David about Jonathan's surviving son?
options: He was lame in both feet
explanation: David still welcomed him. “There is still Jonathan’s son, who is lame in both feet.” (2 Samuel 9:3, BSB)

content: What was the name of Jonathan's son whom King David welcomed?
explanation: He fell facedown before David. “And when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he fell facedown in reverence.” (2 Samuel 9:6, BSB)

content: Bathsheba was the wife of which soldier in King David's army?
explanation: David sinned against him. “This is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite.” (2 Samuel 11:3, BSB)

content: In Nathan's story, how many times over did David say the rich man must pay for the lamb?
explanation: David was angry before he saw his own sin. “he must pay for the lamb four times over.” (2 Samuel 12:6, BSB)

content: Which of David's sons stole the hearts of the men of Israel?
explanation: He turned people against the king. “In this way he stole the hearts of the men of Israel.” (2 Samuel 15:6, BSB)

content: When Absalom rode under a large oak, what got caught in the tree?
explanation: He was left hanging in midair. “Absalom’s head was caught fast in the tree.” (2 Samuel 18:9, BSB)

content: What did King David cry out when he heard Absalom had died?
explanation: He wished he had died instead. “O my son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom!” (2 Samuel 18:33, BSB)

content: When his mighty men brought water from Bethlehem's well, what did David do?
options: Poured it out to the LORD
explanation: They had risked their lives for it. “But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD” (2 Samuel 23:16, BSB)

content: Why did King David insist on paying for the threshing floor?
explanation: True worship costs something. “for I will not offer to the LORD my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing.” (2 Samuel 24:24, BSB)

content: How long did David reign over Judah in Hebron?
explanation: Then he reigned in Jerusalem. “In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months” (2 Samuel 5:5, BSB)

content: How many years did David reign in Jerusalem over all Israel and Judah?
explanation: His total reign was forty years. “and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.” (2 Samuel 5:5, BSB)

content: How old was Mephibosheth when his nurse dropped him and he became lame?
explanation: She was fleeing after Saul's death. “He was five years old when the report about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel.” (2 Samuel 4:4, BSB)

content: In which town was Mephibosheth living when David asked for him?
explanation: He was at the house of Machir. “he is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir son of Ammiel.” (2 Samuel 9:4, BSB)

content: Who was the servant of Saul's family who told David about Mephibosheth?
explanation: He was summoned to the king. “And there was a servant of Saul’s family named Ziba.” (2 Samuel 9:2, BSB)

content: How long did the ark stay at Obed-edom's house?
explanation: The LORD blessed his household. “Thus the ark of the LORD remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite for three months” (2 Samuel 6:11, BSB)

content: In his last words, what does David call himself?
explanation: He wrote many psalms. “and the sweet psalmist of Israel” (2 Samuel 23:1, BSB)

content: How much did David pay for the threshing floor and oxen?
explanation: He refused it as a gift. “So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.” (2 Samuel 24:24, BSB)

content: What was David wearing when he danced before the ark?
explanation: He worshiped humbly. “And David, wearing a linen ephod, danced with all his might before the LORD” (2 Samuel 6:14, BSB)
